'''Avin Solus''' was a [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who resided at the Mandalorian [[City/Legends|settlement]] of [[Arumorut]], located on the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Vlemoth Port]], in the [[Standard year/Legends|years]] that followed the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. A [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] by trade, Solus and several other mercenaries from Arumorut were contracted by a local [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] to eliminate the operation of a [[Thalassian/Legends|Thalassian]] [[Slaver/Legends|slaver]] named [[Nok (Thalassian)|Nok]]. Nok learned of the Mandalorians' impending assault and laid a trap for the mercenaries, but one of the Thalassian's [[Slavery/Legends|slaves]]—a five-year-old boy—warned the Mandalorians of the trap before Nok was able to spring it. After the battle was through, Avin Solus [[Gai bal manda|adopted]] the young boy, [[Kad Solus/Legends|Kad Solus]], and raised him as his own son at Arumorut.<ref name="FLT" />

==Behind the scenes==
Avin Solus was first introduced to the ''[[Star Wars]]'' universe in the [[roleplaying game]] adventure book ''[[Friends Like These]]'', published on [[December 8]], [[2016]] by [[Fantasy Flight Games]].
